learning_outcomes.text: Creates and edits points, lines, axes, curves, and geometric groups using basic wireframe modeling tools.
It creates two- and three-dimensional surface models using modeling methods such as projection, intersection, offset, sweep, revolve, and extrude.
It obtains the desired geometry by performing operations such as merging, trimming, cutting, repairing, duplicating, converting, and deforming on surface models.
Designs functional 3D models suitable for production using advanced wireframe and surface modeling techniques, and evaluates their accuracy.
Students can create complex three-dimensional geometries using wireframe and surface modeling methods and perform advanced editing operations on these models.

syllabus_topics: Introduction to wireframe and surface model design.
Creation of geometric groups and their designation as objects of study. Drawing of points, lines, axes, and composite lines.
Projection operations. Obtaining the intersection line of two objects. Drawing circles. Rounding and joining the ends of curves. Drawing 3D curves.
Creating a surface by elevating and rotating a wireframe object. Drawing a sphere and a cylinder. Translating a surface. Generating a surface by sweeping.
Creating a surface by filling the space between wireframe objects. Creating a multi-section surface. Bridging between surfaces.
Joining and repairing surfaces. Trimming and cutting operations on surfaces. Subtraction operation from a solid or surface model.
Moving, rotating, mirroring, scaling, and copying surface and wireframe objects.
Obtaining the developments and projections of surfaces.
Introduction to advanced model design. Point assignment. Projection and intersection.
Creating offset and parallel curves in 3D space. Drawing 3D circles and cones.
Surface offset operations. Object extraction operations from solid or surface models.
Rounding the corners of surface models. Rectangular and circular patterning of surface models.
Creating embossing on surface models. Deforming the surface based on curves and the surface itself.
bibliography: Catia V5R15 ile modelleme, A. Özdemir, M. Turgut, Z. Tek, 2004.
